Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to resolve ambiguity in the sources it retrieved regarding the location of Rutgers University. This led to the Planner being unable to conclusively verify the exact main campus locations for Rutgers University and subsequently issuing redundant instructions to conduct similar searches without resolving the ambiguity. The error caused inefficiency in the workflow and excessive loops rather than achieving a timely resolution to the query.
